procedure: Record description as first written: starter and reference proofs of the seven-task lab after applying independent-critic fixes, local run 2026-11-19. Commit as first written: working tree on cc/spring-basics-lab (see git history for the committing SHA); 4b340991 is the commit whose coding-lab tree matches every artifactHashes entry below.

Copied the lab to private scratch twice (a starter copy and a reference copy). The Maven repository ~/.m2 already held Spring Boot 4.1.2; the setup command was not repeated online and mvn -q -o test ran offline.
Ran the shipped starter with mvn -q -o test.

Overlaid a private reference solution (CatalogConfig with the @Configuration and @Bean annotations, WorkshopController, WorkshopsApplication with scanBasePackages and SpringApplication.run, and src/main/resources/application.properties; the reference is kept outside the repository) and ran mvn -q -o test again after deleting target.
result: Reference (the independent SME critic solution, adapted): mvn -q -o test exited 0; workshops.WorkshopApiTest Tests run: 6, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0 and workshops.WorkshopsApplicationMainTest Tests run: 1, Failures: 0, Errors: 0, Skipped: 0, matching expected/test-summary.txt.
starterRun: Shipped starter: mvn -q -o test exited 1 with 7 tests, 7 failures, 0 errors, failing exactly the declared failingTests, each on its own task assertion (Task 1 now fails on the explicit one-WorkshopCatalog-bean assertion).
cleanup: The runs created only starter/target inside the lab; after the documented cleanup removed it, the only differences from the exported commit were the three privately staged learner paths.
otherSystems: Linux and Windows runs are not recorded; hosted CI is disabled, so this macOS run is local evidence only.
testScope: Tasks 1-3, 5 and 6 are checked over MockMvc by HTTP status codes, headers and JSON bodies for the listed inputs; Task 4 by the two property values and by the settings file being built from src/main/resources; Task 7 by calling WorkshopsApplication.main with --server.port=0, checking that the port argument reached Spring, and sending one real HTTP request with a 10-second timeout. The tests do not check which Java constructs the code uses.
variantRuns: Variants of the reference run in this pass: application.properties in the starter folder instead of src/main/resources fails the Task 4 test; a main that drops args fails the Task 7 test with 'main must pass its args to Spring Boot'; scanning only the about package passes the Task 5 test and is caught by the tests for Tasks 1, 2, 3 and 6 and by Task 7 (404 on workshops paths). The earlier nine-task adversarial variants were not re-run on the seven-task lab. Not run: a groupSize bound as a String.
